title: Salesforce Buys Military AI Startup Rune in Reported $375M Deal
summary:
The cloud software provider is growing its presence in the defense sector with the purchase of a company that develops specialized artificial intelligence for logistics in remote environments. The agreement to acquire Rune Technologies will link frontline field operations with corporate enterprise workflows to improve mission readiness for users with limited connectivity.

The deal is valued at $375M in cash and stock, according to people familiar with the matter, and expands the year-old Missionforce defense business. Before the sale, Rune had raised approximately $30M in funding from venture capital firms including Andreessen Horowitz.
